thread:
liz: FYI Reseller Partner 'ClearGate' (CG-55) submitted dispute on INV-2026-05-03. They say partner-reseller discount didn't apply to a subset of dedicated hours billed to two subsidiaries. Asking for a retro allocation/credit.

marta: Can you paste the invoice lines and show what they expected vs billed?

liz: INV-2026-05-03 lines: 
- dedicated_reserved_hours: 1,200 hrs @ $0.65 = $780. Billed without partner discount on 400 hrs that were supposed to be assigned to subsidiary CG-55-EU. Expected partner discount 20% on those 400 hrs = $52 credit. They want invoice reallocation or a credit memo.

jason: Checked billing allocation logs. During customer consolidation, the marketplace-tagging job used the parent account for the entire usage window due to a race when the subaccount mapping updated. Snippet: ```
2026-05-02T22:04:11Z ERROR allocation-service: missing subaccount mapping for usage batch id=ugc-77, fallback=parent_account CG-55 request=rz7
```

billing-bot: Created FIN-4999 to track ClearGate reseller allocation credit; linked to INV-2026-05-03.

marta: Policy: partner/reseller contractual discounts must be honored; if system mis-attributed usage we issue retro credit or reallocate. Given this is a partner contract, recommend reallocation in ledger and create credit memo for the net difference to keep AR clean. Propose credit $52. Any goodwill?

liz: Customer is strategic reseller; they asked only for correct allocation. No additional goodwill needed.

owen: I can approve ledger adjustments for partner contracts up to $2k. Need short justification text and GL.

marta: Ledger note: "Usage mis-attributed to parent during subaccount mapping race; reallocated 400 hrs to CG-55-EU and issued retro credit $52 to correct partner discount. Approved by finance lead owen." GL: SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026.

owen: Approved. Please do reallocation + credit memo; prefer apply as credit memo CM-2026-089 attached to invoice so AR stays consistent.

marta: Creating credit memo CM-2026-089 for $52, applying to INV-2026-05-03, posting reallocation entries and recording GL SALES_RETRO_CREDITS_2026. Attaching FIN-4999.

billing-bot: CM-2026-089 created and applied to INV-2026-05-03; reallocation journal posted. Ticket FIN-4999 updated.

jason: I'll add a guard to the allocation-job to retry mapping lookups and add a post-run reconciliation to detect parent-only attributions for multi-subaccount customers. Opening infra PR and linking to FIN-4999.

marta: Add the reconciliation SQL and runbook steps to FIN-4999 for audit evidence.

liz: Notified ClearGate; they confirmed credit applied and asked for the reallocation confirmation for their records.

owen: Mark FIN-4999 resolved once PR + runbook attached. Good catch.

marta: FIN-4999 moved to resolved; CM-2026-089 attached; invoice notes updated. Closing loop.

liz: Thanks team :white_check_mark:
